acceptance.given: A network capability declaration is being created or validated.

oracle.expected: The declaration contains an explicit owner for redirect handling.
forbidden: Redirect handling has no declared owner.

acceptance.then: Validation confirms that redirect handling ownership is declared.
acceptance.when: The declaration validator evaluates network capability ownership fields.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the declaration validation selector against a network capability declaration whose redirect owner is absent; the validator must reject the declaration.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require an explicit redirect-handling owner in the network capability declaration contract.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; removing the requirement restores prior declaration behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: redirect owner absent or unknown -> redirect owner explicitly declared
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Declaration validation returns success only when a non-empty redirect owner is present.

acceptance.given: Package A setup and execution actions are represented by the package's declared command and action set.

oracle.expected: A static inspection of Package A setup and execution actions finds no network-tool installation command or installation step.
oracle.observable: The Package A action manifest and validator output contain no network-tool installation invocation, dependency, or setup step.

acceptance.then: The Package A validation check rejects any action set that installs network tools and accepts only an action set without such installation.
acceptance.when: During Package A setup or execution review, before the package is considered complete.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Package A static action-inspection selector against a manifest containing a network-tool installation command; the check must fail and identify the prohibited installation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce a Package A constraint that setup and execution cannot install network tools.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback would remove the static no-installation constraint.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A action set may contain installation -> Package A action set contains no network-tool installation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Package A validation passes only when its inspected setup and execution actions contain no network-tool installation.
